rupfen.et: From Middle High German rupfen, ropfen, from Old High German rophōn, from Proto-West Germanic *ruppōn. Intensive form of raufen, which see for more. Related but not immediately cognate with English rip.

ruppig.et: 18th century, from Low and Central German dialects. Deverbal from Middle Low German and northern Middle High German ruppen, roppen, cognate of rupfen (“to pluck”), which see.
